title: InvScope
description: Real-time inventory viewer for Spigot servers. Use /invsee to inspect any online player's full inventory, armor, hotbar, and offhand, and /endersee for their ender chest. Supports live two-way editing, permission gating, and exempt/bypass roles.
body:
# InvScope

**The cleanest real-time inventory viewer for Spigot servers.**  
Inspect any online player's inventory or ender chest live, no lag, no guesswork.

[![Modrinth Downloads](https://img.shields.io/modrinth/dt/sZnIhvGW?style=for-the-badge&color=00AF5C&logo=modrinth&logoColor=white)](https://modrinth.com/mod/sZnIhvGW) [![Website](https://img.shields.io/badge/web-aboutcapy.dev-brightgreen?style=for-the-badge&logo=icloud&logoColor=white)](https://aboutcapy.dev) [![Wiki](https://img.shields.io/badge/wiki-docs.aboutcapy.dev-blue?style=for-the-badge&logo=readme&logoColor=white)](https://docs.aboutcapy.dev/invscope) 

## Features

- **View full inventories** — armor, offhand, hotbar, and all storage slots in one clean GUI
- **View ender chests** — dedicated `/endersee` command with its own permission
- **Live two-way editing** — changes made in the GUI instantly apply to the target player
- **Real-time sync** — GUI auto-refreshes every 2 ticks; pickups, drops, and consumption all trigger updates
- **Armor slot indicators** — labeled light-blue glass panes show empty armor/offhand slots at a glance
- **Exempt system** — give players `invscope.exempt` to protect their inventory from being viewed
- **Fully configurable** — filler material, refresh rate, open sound, and all messages in `config.yml`
- **Live reload** — `/invscope reload` reloads config without restarting

## Commands

| Command | Description |
|---------|-------------|
| `/invsee <player>` | View a player's inventory |
| `/endersee <player>` | View a player's ender chest |
| `/io <player>` | View a player's inventory |
| `/ec <player>` | View a player's ender chest |
| `/invscope reload` | Reload the config |
| `/invscope version` | Show plugin version |

## Permissions

| Permission | Default | Description |
|------------|---------|-------------|
| invscope.use | false | Legacy alias for /invsee permission |
| invscope.edit | false | Legacy alias for editing viewed inventories |
| invscope.inventory.other | op | View others inventories |
| invscope.inventory.editother | op | Edit others inventories |
| invscope.ender | false | Legacy alias for /endersee permission |
| invscope.ender.other | op | View others ender chests |
| invscope.ender.edit | false | Legacy alias for editing viewed ender chests |
| invscope.exempt | false | Protect from being viewed |
| invscope.bypass | op | View exempt players anyway |
| invscope.admin | op | Use /invscope reload and version |
| invscope.inventory.* | op | All inventory permissions |
| invscope.ender.* | op | All ender chest permissions |
| invscope.* | op | All permissions |

## GUI Layout
```
[ Helmet ][ Chest ][ Legs ][ Boots ][ Offhand ][◼][◼][◼][◼]
[ Inventory rows 1 – 3 ]
[ Hotbar ]
[◼][◼][◼][◼][◼][◼][◼][◼][◼]
```
Empty armor slots show labeled indicators, no mystery air slots.

## Requirements

- **Spigot / Paper** 1.20.4+
- **Java** 17+
